title: From Full-File Review to Exception Review
subtitle: A proposal for Farnsworth: AI-assisted survey quality that reduces PM review time while strengthening data-quality assurance across Decipher cleaning, open-end QA, and the PM exception workflow.

customer_words.bottleneck: PMs spend 1+ hour reviewing the AI output to confirm it caught every poor-quality respondent, and they do this a few times a week on batches of roughly 50-200.
customer_words.adoption_gap: The custom GPT has not reached company-wide adoption because it is too slow and not trusted for open-ended review.

pilot.price_policy: Hold for SOW unless asked in meeting.
